title: BANGLANIRTOX: A Large-scale Parallel Corpus for Explainable AI in Bengali Text Detoxification
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical task of Bengali text detoxification, creating a parallel corpus (BANGLANIRTOX) and a pipeline using LLMs. While some examples of toxic text include religious topics (e.g., profiting from religion), the paper's objective is linguistic style transfer and toxicity removal rather than evaluating or benchmarking religious, spiritual, or ethical systems.
